name: underline-animation

frames.best_why: Read.cv is fully flooded with a solid block and flipped text while the other links stay legible around it.

tagline: Hovering a link grows, sweeps or floods an underline beneath it.
summary: A set of link hover effects: one line swells from the centre, others sweep in and out, and another rises into a solid block that flips the text colour. Meant for typographic link lists.
appearance: A short link list on black: a grey CONTACT label sits beside six blue uppercase links stacked in two groups, each link underlined by a thin blue line close beneath the text.
behaviour: Hovering a link plays one of four underline motions: a line grows from the centre, slides in then back out, or expands upward into a filled block that darkens the text. Each effect settles back when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Contact label beside LinkedIn, Instagram, Dribbble, Read.cv and two @stashui.dev email links
search_phrases: link with line that grows on hover
blue links on a dark page
use_when: Portfolio or footer link lists need a restrained hover flourish that stays typographic and never shifts layout.
avoid_when: Touch screens or designs that depend on focus states, because every effect is bound to hover only.
customise: Each variant takes children plus as, className, underline size ratios and a transition. UnderlineToBackground also needs targetTextColor; colours otherwise follow the surrounding currentColor.
weight_why: Four tiny motion spans that animate only on hover and are idle otherwise.

a11y.note: Every effect fires on hover only, so keyboard focus shows no underline, and no reduced-motion check exists.

issues: All links sit permanently underlined in frame 1, though most variants draw the line only while hovered.
polish_why: Clean and legible, but the plain black demo and barely changing frames make it feel ordinary.
